statement: Re-upload idempotence (N-0110 repair): after a sell-through load applies, an older stored row is superseded only when the load that last wrote it read files byte-identical (sha256 of the stored file) to files in this load, this load restates the same customer and product, and this load did not write that key. Superseded rows move verbatim (row_json) into fact_customer_sellthrough_superseded with the superseding load and reason; staging rows stay. Same file name alone is not enough (a customer can resend 'ASUS WEEK 31.xlsx' each year). A load whose old file is gone, or with a failed chunk, supersedes nothing. Reversible: drop the step; the moved rows can be copied back.
